settings
{
	modes
	{
		Team Deathmatch
		{
			enabled maps
			{
				Workshop Chamber
			}
		}
	}
}

rule ("Header") {
    event {
        Ongoing - Global;
    }
    actions {
        Disable Inspector Recording;
        Create HUD Text(All Players(All Teams), Custom String("Hello, Workshop!"), Null, Null, Left, 0, Color(White), Null, Null, Visible To Sort Order String and Color, Default Visibility);
    }
}

rule ("Welcome") {
    event {
        Ongoing - Each Player;
        All;
        All;
    }
    conditions {
        Has Spawned(Event Player) == True;
    }
    actions {
        Small Message(Event Player, Custom String("Welcome, {0}!", Event Player));
    }
}
